s.note: Twisted sesame bread rings glazed with grape molasses, with feta
s.how: Knead 350g plain flour, 7g dry yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 220ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil for 10 minutes and rise for an hour. Divide into 8, roll each into two thin ropes, twist together and join into rings. Dip in 80ml grape molasses mixed with 80ml water, then in 120g sesame seeds. Rest 15 minutes and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until deep golden. Serve warm with feta.

s.note: Black mussels stuffed with spiced rice, pine nuts and currants, steamed and served with lemon
s.how: Soak 150g rice for 20 minutes. Fry an onion and 2 tbsp pine nuts in 3 tbsp oil, add the rice, allspice, cinnamon, tomato paste, sugar, salt, pepper, currants and 250ml water and simmer covered for 10 minutes, then stir in dill and mint and cool. Prise open 24 cleaned mussels at the flat edge without separating the shells, fill each with rice and close. Pack into a pot with 200ml water, weigh down with a plate and steam for 20 minutes. Serve at room temperature with lemon.

m.note: Pan-fried sole in nutty brown butter with lemon, capers and parsley, new potatoes and green beans
m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes until tender and blanch 250g green beans. Season 600g sole fillets, dust with flour and fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 2 minutes a side. Brown 80g butter until nutty, add the juice of a lemon, a tbsp of capers and parsley and spoon over the fish. Serve with the potatoes, beans and lemon wedges.

w.note: Rosewater Turkish delight with pistachios, cut into cubes and rolled in icing sugar
w.how: Boil 600g sugar, 200ml water and 1 tbsp lemon juice to 115C. Cook 100g cornflour, 1 tsp cream of tartar and 600ml water to a thick paste, slowly whisk in the syrup and simmer very gently for an hour, stirring often, until pale gold and very thick. Stir in 1.5 tbsp rosewater, a few drops of pink colouring and 50g pistachios, pour into an oiled, lined 20cm tin and set overnight. Cut into cubes and toss in icing sugar and cornflour.

d.note: Aniseed raki clouded over ice with pomegranate juice, lemon, soda, mint and pomegranate seeds
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 30ml raki, a little lemon juice and sugar syrup to each and stir until cloudy. Top with 200ml pomegranate juice and 200ml soda between them and finish with mint and pomegranate seeds.
